{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Thermostat with C-Wire Power Adapter; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa compatibility interests me, but I have no current thermostat replacement need or confirmed wiring compatibility.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen, 2021 release) - Glacier White - with 30-day FREE trial of Alexa Together (monthly auto-renewal); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger screen appeals to me, but my recent Echo Show 5 purchase makes another display less useful right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen) Adjustable Stand | Glacier White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent display is an Echo Show 5, so this stand does not match the device I need it for.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ring Stick Up Cam Battery HD security camera with custom privacy controls, Simple setup, Works with Alexa - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for home monitoring because it works with my Alexa devices and builds on my earlier interest in home security.
ItemID: NA; Title: GTEK Portable Monitor 15.8 Inch IPS Full HD 1920 x 1080P Screen with Speaker, Second Dual Computer Display, Wider Than 15.6 Inch, External Travel Monitor for MacBook Laptop PC, Includes Smart Cover; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy computer accessories frequently, but my history gives me no clear reason to add a portable second screen now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my streaming interests, but I recently bought a Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle and would skip a redundant device.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics Rotating 6-Outlet Surge Protector Wall Mount, 1080 Joules, White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this as a practical way to power my growing collection of electronics, with rotating outlets helping accommodate adapters.
ItemID: NA; Title: Logitech M170 Wireless Mouse for PC, Mac, Laptop, 2.4 GHz with USB Mini Receiver, Optical Tracking, 12-Months Battery Life, Ambidextrous - Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Wireless mice fit my interests, but this offers no clear upgrade over the Bluetooth and ergonomic mice I have previously selected.
ItemID: NA; Title: 6Ft Power Strip Surge Protector - Yintar Extension Cord with 6 AC Outlets and 3 USB Ports for for Home, Office, Dorm Essentials, 1680 Joules, ETL Listed, (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The extra outlets and USB ports are useful, but I would choose the rotating wall-mounted option on this visit instead.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa-compatible security appeals to me, but I would start with the single Ring camera before committing to a whole-home bundle."}
